_about: The credit rubric the v2 CAM harness sets signals from (cam_findings.py). Bands follow the EVAM CAM prompt's A3 tables; the credit team owns this file — change a threshold or a sentence here, not in code. Signals: GREEN supports the credit, AMBER to watch or resolve, RED a direct, unmitigated path to loss on this facility. Point WORKFLOWS_CAM_RUBRIC_PATH at an edited copy to use it. A rule's "green_needs" lists conditions under which its GREEN is AMBER instead (unaudited: the period is not audited; cc_overdrawn: a CC/OD went over its limit); "append" adds PRISM's note to its sentence No conflict found is no signal at all: PRISM compares only the few figures it reads twice. (leverage_note: leverage on the bureau's current outstanding when that is above the statements' debt; dscr_note: how an estimated DSCR was made). "params": the borrower's margin and the haircuts the limit sizing and current-asset cover use.
